summary: Nexa Resources S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing the voting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting and Extraordinary General Meeting held on June 25, 2026. The exhibits include minutes and detailed vote tallies for routine agenda items: approval of annual accounts, board discharge, director re-elections, auditor reappointment, and a share premium distribution. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring—is disclosed. This is a regulatory filing of ordinary corporate governance outcomes with no strategic or structural change warranting classification as a special situation.
